structure.definition: Actual public key glyph visible in the overlay region; cumulative sightings on the stored winning route, in tile-removal moves. No-key boards use null for time-to-both, not zero.

witness.ambiguityNote: These are omniscient engine removal actions on the stored winning witness. Repeated information-only peeks are separate physical taps.
